sources.title: JADEPUFFER: 6 Things to Know About AI-Driven Ransomware
sources.snippet: An LLM ran a complete ransomware operation without a human at the keyboard. JADEPUFFER exploited Langflow and encrypted a prod database.

sources.title: JadePuffer: The First AI-Run Ransomware Attack | devMorph Blog
sources.snippet: An AI agent broke into a server, stole credentials, moved across a network, encrypted a production database, and left a ransom note. Nobody was at the keyboard while it happened. Security researchers at Sysdig gave it a name: JadePuffer — the first documented ransomware operation run start to finish by a large language model.
